name: fitness-feature
title_zh: 从 UI 一路切到数据库的 .NET 10 全栈纵切
tagline_zh: 新功能不再只改一半：UI、API、业务规则、持久化、授权、测试、进度文档一次对齐，省得你回头补漏。
tagline_en: One feature, every layer: UI, API, rules, persistence, authz, tests and progress notes updated together.
desc_en: Implement a small FitnessApp product feature end to end across the existing .NET 10 hosted Blazor WebAssembly layers. Use for new vertical slices or changes that require coordinated UI, API, business rules, persistence, authorization, tests, and project progress updates. Do not use for review-only, design-only, or pull-request-only work.
why_zh: 它把「纵切片」当交付单位：先摸清现有分层与约定，再逐层落地并同步测试与进度记录。
why_en: It treats a vertical slice as the unit of delivery: reads your existing layers and conventions first, then lands each layer with.
limit_zh: 只认 .NET 10 hosted Blazor WebAssembly 这套分层；纯审查、纯设计。
limit_en: Only for .NET 10 hosted Blazor WebAssembly layering; no review-only, design-only or PR-only work. If the layers or test projects are missing, it.
title_en: Full-stack vertical slice from Blazor UI down to EF Core
